blue-dragon-head-with-orange-tongue.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:19
blue-dragon-head-with-orange-tongue.description: The head of a blue dragon in profile facing left, cut from the terminal of an initial. It has a pointed snout, a white-rimmed eye, a swept-back blue crest with white hatching and an open mouth with a dark red interior and white teeth, from which a long orange tongue curls out to the lower left. A short stub of neck remains at the right. Black outlines; transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

blue-dragon-head-with-orange-tongue.quality: Small master, 339 px wide; the neck ends in a cut edge at the right.
blue-dragon-head-with-orange-tongue.title: Blue dragon head with orange tongue
usage_notes: Head only; the neck is cut where it met the letter, so place it against a stem, a letter or the end of a border.

blue-serrated-floret-with-red-gold-cente.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
blue-serrated-floret-with-red-gold-cente.description: A small loosely painted floret of about seven blue serrated petals around an orange-red centre topped with a gold disc, one of the florets scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

blue-serrated-floret-with-red-gold-cente.quality: Loose paint with broken, partly transparent petal edges.
blue-serrated-floret-with-red-gold-cente.title: Blue serrated floret with gold centre
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; keep it small.

blue-webbed-fan-leaf.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
blue-webbed-fan-leaf.description: A fan-shaped blue leaf spreading to the left from a narrow base at the right, its six pointed hooked tips joined by pale ribbed webbing like a bat's wing, with a tall curling tendril at the top and a pink-red lobe folded behind it at the upper right. Outlined in black on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

blue-webbed-fan-leaf.title: Blue webbed fan leaf

crowned-david-seated-playing-harp.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29
crowned-david-seated-playing-harp.description: King David, crowned in gold, with brown hair and beard, sits turned slightly to the right in a loose brown robe with an ermine-spotted collar and red pointed shoes, his right hand at the strings of a gold harp held at his side beside a small purple flower. He looks out at the viewer. Cut from the historiated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial G from an antiphonary depicting David as a musician

crowned-david-seated-playing-harp.title: King David playing the harp

crowned-winged-figure-with-chalice.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
crowned-winged-figure-with-chalice.description: A standing barefoot figure with two faces under one gold crown set with blue stones, a bearded profile looking left and a beardless one looking right. The long robe is gold and red on the left half and black on the right. A gold feathered wing spreads at the left, its lower part coiling into a spiral with a small head, and a blue wing with white drop markings spreads at the right. The right hand holds a dark gold-rimmed chalice from which three green serpent heads rise. Cut from the miniature; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

crowned-winged-figure-with-chalice.title: Crowned two-faced winged figure with serpent chalice
usage_notes: Cut-out of the figure in two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene, without the ground; the feet end flat where they stood on the rocks.

dark-seed-pod-sprig.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
dark-seed-pod-sprig.description: An upright sprig on a mottled yellow-green stem that forks into four curving stalks, each ending in a hanging oval seed pod painted dark brown-black with a glossy highlight. Cut from the ground of the miniature at the right of the figure; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

dark-seed-pod-sprig.title: Sprig with four dark seed pods
usage_notes: The better-preserved of the two sprigs flanking the figure in two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene; the stem is cut flat at the bottom where it met the ground.

diving-brown-bird-with-red-face.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29
diving-brown-bird-with-red-face.description: A brown bird with pale cream underparts dives to the lower left, both wings raised above its back and its forked tail at the upper right; its head is ringed in red around the eye and bill. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial G from an antiphonary depicting David as a musician

diving-brown-bird-with-red-face.title: Diving brown bird with red face

floral-spray-with-blue-flowers.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
floral-spray-with-blue-flowers.description: A long horizontal spray of green, white-highlighted stems running from a blue acanthus curl with a pink-tan leaf at the left to a slender blue and gold leaf at the right, with a tuft of green grass at its centre. Along it hang two pale blue many-petalled flowers, green strap leaves, orange buds and gold discs, and small gold-centred blue florets and orange dots are scattered around the stems. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

floral-spray-with-blue-flowers.title: Horizontal floral spray with blue flowers
usage_notes: Finite horizontal piece with terminal ends, not a repeat; it comes from the same border as tall-floral-bar-with-knotted-red-blue-ribbons, which it meets at right angles.
The loose florets and the gold disc from the same border can be scattered around it as in the source.

gold-blue-and-red-foliate-panel.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:20
gold-blue-and-red-foliate-panel.description: A rectangular panel on a burnished gold ground, cut from a border. Gold bars with a blue stripe and red curled ends run along the top and bottom and extend into pointed gold finials at the four corners. A vertical blue column in the centre holds three squares, each filled with white radiating strokes around a central dot. On either side, curling red and blue stems carry three-lobed leaves in red, blue and green with white highlights and dots. Opaque within the panel; transparent outside.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

gold-blue-and-red-foliate-panel.quality: The gold leaf is worn and scratched, a few paint losses show as pale flecks along the right side, and the panel is slightly out of square.
gold-blue-and-red-foliate-panel.title: Gold panel with blue star column and red and blue vines
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its own gold ground; place it as a plate or a headpiece, not as a cut-out.

gold-centred-red-dot.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
gold-centred-red-dot.description: A small round dab of orange-red paint with a gold disc laid over it, its brushed edge uneven, one of the gold-centred dots scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

gold-centred-red-dot.quality: Only 100 px across, so it softens above native size.
gold-centred-red-dot.title: Small red and gold painted disc
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; it is tiny, keep it near native size.

gold-seed-pod-sprig.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
gold-seed-pod-sprig.description: The remains of an upright sprig, a dark green stem with two curving side stalks and faint traces of about six gold and red seed pods around it, most of the paint lost so that the pods survive as scattered flakes without outlines. Cut from the ground of the miniature at the left of the figure; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

gold-seed-pod-sprig.quality: Heavy original paint loss; half of the painted pixels are semi-transparent and the pods are fragmentary.
gold-seed-pod-sprig.title: Faded sprig with gold seed pods
usage_notes: Kept as it survives; use it for a worn, ghostly plant or pair it with dark-seed-pod-sprig as in the source, where the two flank the figure.

grapevine-with-two-purple-clusters.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29
grapevine-with-two-purple-clusters.description: A vertical grapevine on a green stem with curling tendrils, carrying two clusters of purple grapes with white highlights, three large green vine leaves, three red lily-like flowers, a small rosy apple-like fruit at the right and gold-edged leaves. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; opaque paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial G from an antiphonary depicting David as a musician

grapevine-with-two-purple-clusters.title: Grapevine with two purple grape clusters

green-feathered-floret-with-red-gold-cen.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
green-feathered-floret-with-red-gold-cen.description: A small four-pointed floret of fine green hatched strokes forming a diamond with feathered tips around an orange-red centre topped with a gold disc, one of the florets scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

green-feathered-floret-with-red-gold-cen.title: Green feathered floret with gold centre
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; keep it small.

green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7
green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish.description: A flourish from the upper left of an initial. A broad ochre-gold leaf curls into spirals at the top right and at the bottom, a green acanthus leaf fills the centre, a blue curled leaf sits at the lower right, and thin green stems with spiral tendrils and fern-like fronds spread outward. A spray of yellow bell-shaped flowers on green stems rises at the top, and a tapering red beaded curl extends to the left. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial A from an antiphonary depicting the Agnus Dei

green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish.title: Gold and green leaf flourish with yellow flowers
usage_notes: Sat at the upper left of the initial, with pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish below; the red beaded curl at the left is the natural outer edge.

green-lobed-leaf-with-pointed-tip.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19
green-lobed-leaf-with-pointed-tip.description: A broad dark green leaf with three rounded lobes above and a pointed lobe below, veined with pale brown-white strokes and outlined in black, with a few flecks of gold at the tips; a thin pale fringe remains along the outline where it was lifted from the blue stroke of the initial. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

green-lobed-leaf-with-pointed-tip.quality: Pale fringe along the outline from the adjoining blue stroke of the initial.
green-lobed-leaf-with-pointed-tip.title: Green lobed leaf with pointed tip

inhabited-initial-s-with-winged-dragon.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:3
inhabited-initial-s-with-winged-dragon.description: The letter S drawn as a rose-red band with white dots and a black outline, curling into a loop that encloses a blue winged dragon. The dragon's blue head with pointed ears faces right at the top right, an orange bat wing spreads across the centre, and its blue hind leg rests on the lower curve beside a blue and red lobed leaf. Red, blue and orange acanthus sprays with a small blue creature head grow from the left side of the letter. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

inhabited-initial-s-with-winged-dragon.title: Inhabited initial S with a winged dragon
usage_notes: The whole inhabited letter, its S body and the foliage at the left included; the letter and the dragon are one piece and do not separate.

inner-red-and-blue-leaf-scroll.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
inner-red-and-blue-leaf-scroll.description: A dense panel of blue and red-orange leaf scrollwork outlined in black. Thin blue and red stems curl into two large spirals, one at the upper left and one at the lower right, and throw off lobed, trefoil and heart-shaped leaves in blue, red and orange with white dots and vein lines; an orange lobed terminal with a curled tip closes the top. The panel is roughly rectangular, its left and right sides cut straight where the scroll met the border bars. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

inner-red-and-blue-leaf-scroll.quality: Cut straight along the left and right edges where the scroll met the border bars.
inner-red-and-blue-leaf-scroll.title: Red and blue leaf scroll panel
usage_notes: The straight left and right edges are cuts, so it reads best butted against a rule or bar on those sides, as in the source border.

interlaced-blue-red-foliage.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:19
interlaced-blue-red-foliage.description: Two stems, one blue and one rose-red, each with a white centre line and black outline, loop through each other in a symmetrical knot of interlaced circles. Three-lobed leaves in orange, blue and rose sit inside the loops and at the centre, and larger lobed leaves in orange and blue spread from the four corners, all with white dots and highlights. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

interlaced-blue-red-foliage.title: Interlaced blue and rose stems with lobed leaves

lamb-with-cross-and-ribbon.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7
lamb-with-cross-and-ribbon.description: A cream-white lamb lies with its legs folded, body to the right and head turned slightly towards the viewer, with pink ears and muzzle and dark hooves. A thin gold cross staff leans diagonally behind its head, and a blue-grey banderole with traces of lettering winds around the staff and flutters off to the right. Shaded in tan and grey; transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial A from an antiphonary depicting the Agnus Dei

lamb-with-cross-and-ribbon.title: Agnus Dei, lamb lying with cross staff and banderole
usage_notes: The Agnus Dei from the counter of a historiated initial A; the two flourishes from the same cutting are green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish and pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish.

large-red-brown-butterfly-with-cream-win.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29
large-red-brown-butterfly-with-cream-win.description: A large butterfly in profile facing left, its russet red-brown wings closed above the body and crossed by broad cream bars with rows of red and black spots along the margins; the body and the underside of the lower wing are pale blue-grey, with thin brown legs and two long clubbed antennae. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial G from an antiphonary depicting David as a musician

large-red-brown-butterfly-with-cream-win.title: Large red-brown butterfly with cream wing bars
usage_notes: Pairs with small-spotted-butterfly, which faces right at a smaller scale.

left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-ber.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-ber.description: Two scalloped bell-shaped flowers with orange-red petals and dark green calyces hang from a thick black stem, one above and one below, with a gold disc berry on a stalk at the left and thin black tendrils curling to the right. The stem runs off the lower edge. Black line and paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-ber.quality: The black stem is cut at the bottom edge where it joined the border.
left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-ber.title: Two bell flowers and gold berry on black twig
usage_notes: Same twig and flowers as upper-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-berry, from the left side of the same border; hide the cut stem end behind a rule or another piece.

lobed-floral-blue-scroll.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:13
lobed-floral-blue-scroll.description: A blue stem with a white centre line and black outline winds in an S-curve and branches into short side shoots. Six three-lobed leaves hang from it, two orange-red, two green and two blue, each with white highlights and a line of white dots along the centre. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

lobed-floral-blue-scroll.title: Blue S-curved vine with lobed leaves

lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:2
lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower.description: A thin pale pink stem with a black outline curves from the upper left down to the lower right and gives off short side stems. Pointed ivy leaves alternate along it in red, blue and tan, each drawn out into a black hairline tip, and a round gold flower with black hairline rays hangs at the right end. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower.quality: The hairline leaf tips are at partial alpha and fade on dark grounds.
lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower.title: Curving ivy trail with gold flower, lower half
usage_notes: The lower half of one ivy trail; upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flower is the upright half from the same cutting, and the two hang together as a margin border, the upright piece above and this piece running along the bottom.

lower-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19
lower-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.description: A spray fanning out from a cut stem at the right; two gold and orange acanthus leaves with white vein lines reach left and upward, and below them a long pointed blue leaf with white highlights wraps around a pink lobe bearing a white circle and a small white sprig mark, with a short red stub hanging below. Cut from the decorated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

lower-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.quality: Cut straight at the right where the spray met the letter.
lower-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.title: Gold acanthus spray with blue and pink leaves
usage_notes: The lower of the two leaf sprays that sprang from the letter; set its cut stem end at the right against a rule or letter.

michael-and-angels-battling-winged-demon.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 15:14
michael-and-angels-battling-winged-demon.description: The figures of a miniature cut from their ground. Saint Michael in gold armour, with a halo and green, blue and red wings, stands at the centre with his sword raised and one foot on a brown winged dragon with a gold tail. Four angels in white, pink and red robes strike down with swords around him, while a red-clad demon with a bat wing falls at the left behind a blue shield with gold stars and a grey demon with blue bat wings sprawls at the lower right. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Miniature depicting Michael the Archangel fighting the dragon with his angels

michael-and-angels-battling-winged-demon.quality: The sword blades of the two upper angels and the wing of the upper-left angel are cut flat where they ran into the frame of the miniature, at the top and left edges.
michael-and-angels-battling-winged-demon.title: Saint Michael and angels fighting the dragon and demons
usage_notes: Figures only, the painted sky and ground of the miniature are removed; place it as a complete scene and keep its proportions.

orange-maned-hybrid-with-blue-wing.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19
orange-maned-hybrid-with-blue-wing.description: A hybrid creature facing right, with an orange-red beast head with pointed ears and open jaws on a gold-feathered neck and wing, a body curled into a large blue spiral with white hatching and a gold-dotted band, a bearded human face in orange-brown at its rump at the right, and two dark green clawed feet. Outlined in black; cut from the decorated initial, the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

orange-maned-hybrid-with-blue-wing.title: Winged hybrid with orange head and bearded mask

pink-and-red-lobed-leaves-on-blue-stem.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:4
pink-and-red-lobed-leaves-on-blue-stem.description: Two large curling lobed leaves, the left one rose-pink with white highlights and dotted lines, the right one dark red with gold-edged lobes and white highlights, meet over a small pink pod. A blue stem with a white centre line loops into a knot below them and ends at the bottom. Black outlines; transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

pink-and-red-lobed-leaves-on-blue-stem.title: Pink and dark red lobed leaves on a knotted blue stem
usage_notes: From the same initial as red-flower-and-blue-leaf-on-pale-forked-stem, in the same hand and palette; the two pair well on one page.

pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7
pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish.description: A flourish from the lower part of an initial. A red bell-shaped flower with a blue calyx sits at the top right, a chain of blue beads tapering upward curves away from it to the upper left, and green curling leaves and stems spiral downward carrying three pink five-petal flowers, an orange curled leaf and a dark green pod, with a red beaded curl at the lower left. Darker outlines and white highlights; transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial A from an antiphonary depicting the Agnus Dei

pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish.title: Green scroll flourish with pink flowers and blue bead chain
usage_notes: Sat below the initial, with green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish above; the blue bead chain is the stem that joined the two, so keep it when pairing them.

reclining-green-dragon-biting-gold-bar.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
reclining-green-dragon-biting-gold-bar.description: A long green dragon with russet shading lies stretched out facing left, its jaws closed on a gold rectangular rod; it has a slender curved neck, small clawed forelegs, a dark feathered wing with a gold-brown underside raised over its back at the right and a tail trailing to the right. Cut from the ground of the miniature; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

reclining-green-dragon-biting-gold-bar.title: Reclining green dragon biting a gold rod
usage_notes: Cut-out of the dragon at the foot of two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene; it lies flat along its belly and reads well as a base-line piece.

red-and-blue-lobed-leaves-on-forked-stem.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:4
red-and-blue-lobed-leaves-on-forked-stem.description: Two curling lobed leaves joined by a pale pink forked stem with a black outline, a dark red leaf with orange and white highlights at the left and a blue leaf with white highlights at the right, with a small ribbed pod where they meet. The stem ends in a short fork at the bottom. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

red-and-blue-lobed-leaves-on-forked-stem.title: Dark red and blue lobed leaves on a pale forked stem
usage_notes: From the same initial as pink-and-red-lobed-leaves-on-blue-stem, in the same hand and palette; the two pair well on one page.

red-lobed-leaf-on-looping-blue-stem.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
red-lobed-leaf-on-looping-blue-stem.description: A fat red-orange lobed leaf with white dots and gold-filled hollows, outlined in black, hangs below a blue and white striped stem that loops over itself and ends in a blunt curled tip at the right. The piece is cut straight along the lower right where it met the border bar. The background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

red-lobed-leaf-on-looping-blue-stem.quality: Cut straight at the lower right where it met the border bar.
red-lobed-leaf-on-looping-blue-stem.title: Red lobed leaf on blue looped stem
usage_notes: Hide the straight cut at the lower right against a rule or bar, as in the source corner.

resurrection-with-tomb-and-four-soldiers.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
resurrection-with-tomb-and-four-soldiers.description: Christ steps out of a grey stone tomb towards the viewer, right hand raised in blessing and a long gold cross-staff with a trefoil cross in his left, wearing a red mantle lined green over his bare chest, fastened with a gold brooch. Four soldiers in grey plate armour surround the tomb, one slumped asleep at the left, one lying on the green grass below, one in a blue surcoat sitting with a halberd at the right and one crouching behind the tomb with hands raised. Cut from the inside of the initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

resurrection-with-tomb-and-four-soldiers.title: Resurrection of Christ with four soldiers
usage_notes: Complete scene from the inside of the initial, standing on its own strip of grass; place it as a picture.

six-leaf-blue-vine.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:4
six-leaf-blue-vine.description: A blue stem with a white centre line and black outline curves down from a curled tip at the top left and branches to both sides. Six five-lobed pointed leaves hang from it, three orange-red, two blue and one green, each with white highlights and a line of white dots down the middle. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

six-leaf-blue-vine.title: Blue vine with six lobed leaves

small-spotted-butterfly.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29
small-spotted-butterfly.description: A small butterfly in profile facing right, its closed wings dark brown along the top and orange-cream below with black and white spots and a blue-green patch near the body; a hairy brown body, thin legs and two antennae. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.object_title: Historiated initial G from an antiphonary depicting David as a musician

small-spotted-butterfly.title: Small spotted butterfly
usage_notes: Pairs with large-red-brown-butterfly-with-cream-wing-bars, which faces left at a larger scale.

tall-floral-bar-with-knotted-red-blue-ri.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3
tall-floral-bar-with-knotted-red-blue-ri.description: A tall vertical bar on a green and gold stem carrying, from top to bottom, blue and gold leaf curls, a large green, pink and gold acanthus fan over a blue and red leaf collar, a pink and gold star flower with a blue centre, a blue and gold acanthus scroll, a blue tulip-like flower, a gold and blue scroll, an interlaced red and blue strapwork lozenge over gold, a blue flower in gold leaves, a red bud and a pink tasselled flower at the foot. Gold discs and small blue and green gold-centred florets are scattered beside the stem. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

tall-floral-bar-with-knotted-red-blue-ri.title: Tall floral bar with red and blue strapwork knot
usage_notes: Finite vertical piece, every motif different, not a repeat; it comes from the same border as floral-spray-with-blue-flowers, which it meets at right angles.
The loose florets and the gold disc from the same border can be scattered beside it as in the source.

thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame.description: A thin rectangular frame, taller than wide, of pink-red paint with worn patches of gold leaf and a thin dark line along its inner edge; the four bands run slightly askew, the top band rising to the right and the left band leaning. Only the paint is opaque; the interior and everything outside the frame are transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame.quality: Not rectangular as painted, the top band rises about 32 px from left to right and the left band drifts about 13 px over its height; band widths vary between about 35 and 45 px and the gold is worn away in patches.
thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame.title: Thin red and gold miniature frame
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, scaled as a whole with content placed in its transparent interior; it is not a border-image because the bands run askew and vary in width.
It is the frame of two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene.

two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-s.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27
two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-s.description: An alchemical figure with two faces under one gold crown, a bearded profile looking left and a beardless one looking right, stands barefoot on green rocky ground in a robe gold and red on the left and black on the right, a gold feathered wing ending in a spiral coil at the left and a blue wing at the right, holding a chalice from which three green serpent heads rise. A green dragon lies on the ground biting a gold rod, and two seed-pod sprigs grow beside the figure, the left one faded. Cut from the miniature; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-s.quality: The left seed-pod sprig is largely lost in the original and survives only as faint fragments.
two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-s.title: Crowned two-faced figure with dragon on rocky ground
usage_notes: The whole picture field of the miniature without its frame; thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame is the frame it sat in, and the figure, dragon and both sprigs are also cut out separately.

upper-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19
upper-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.description: A spray fanning out from a cut stem at the right; a long red-brown leaf with white vein lines reaches left, a gold acanthus lobe hangs below it, and a blue leaf curls over at the top around a pink inner lobe with white sprig marks. Cut from the decorated initial; the background is transparent.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

upper-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.quality: Cut straight at the right where the spray met the letter.
upper-red-gold-and-blue-leaf-spray.title: Red, blue and gold leaf spray with curled tip
usage_notes: The upper of the two leaf sprays that sprang from the letter; set its cut stem end at the right against a rule or letter.

upper-right-red-lobed-leaf-terminal.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
upper-right-red-lobed-leaf-terminal.description: A tall red-orange leaf with three pointed lobes curving to the left, outlined in black with pale highlight strokes and a dark curled tip at the right, the terminal of a scroll; its base is cut where it left the stem. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

upper-right-red-lobed-leaf-terminal.quality: The base is cut where the leaf left its stem.
upper-right-red-lobed-leaf-terminal.title: Red lobed leaf terminal
usage_notes: Terminal of a scroll; set its cut base against a stem or rule.

upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flow.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:2
upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flow.description: A thin pale pink stem with a black outline rises vertically and gives off short side stems to left and right. Pointed ivy leaves alternate along it in tan, red and blue, each drawn out into a long black hairline tip, and a round gold flower with black hairline rays sits to the left of the middle. Transparent background.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flow.quality: The hairline leaf tips are at partial alpha and fade on dark grounds.
upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flow.title: Upright ivy trail with gold flower, upper half
usage_notes: The upright half of one ivy trail; lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower is the lower half from the same cutting, and the two hang together as a margin border, this piece above and the curving piece along the bottom.
Tall piece (about 1 to 2.7); it suits a side margin or a column divider.

upper-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-be.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5
upper-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-be.description: A fine black twig with a gold oval bud at its tip ringed by short strokes and a long tendril rising above it; thin black tendrils curl out from the stem, and at the left and right hang two scalloped bell-shaped flowers with orange-red petals and dark green calyces. Black line and paint on a transparent ground.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection

upper-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-be.title: Two bell flowers and gold bud on black twig
usage_notes: Same twig and flowers as left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-berry, from the top of the same border; the stem is complete at the bottom.

attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M

summary: Decorated, inhabited and historiated initials, border fragments and miniatures from fourteen medieval cuttings of the John Frederick Lewis Collection (Lewis E M) at the Free Library of Philadelphia, digitised by OPenn; 14th to 17th century, Germany, France, Italy and Portugal; grouped by cutting.
